already_implemented: Compact snapshot(false) omits full World material and RGBA rasterization.
CarrierCache reuses materials/RGBA/states/temperature/roles/incarnations by full handle plus material_revision, using Godot packed-value copy-on-write.
Native terrain reconstruction is guarded by hard-surface revision.
Main does not deep-copy an unchanged publication sequence.
source_grounded_repeated_work: CyberObjectShardLab::snapshot serializes all terrain chunk rectangles on every compact snapshot.
CyberObjectShardLab::snapshot serializes each shard geometry rectangle array on every snapshot.
CyberObjectShardLab::snapshot calls Shard::payload_digest for every live shard; this walks the complete captured bbox.
Accounting arrays, admission, and current/lifetime metric dictionaries are rebuilt for each publication.

candidate_reuse_not_implemented.payload_digest: A bounded facade cache must include full handle, material_revision AND native tick (or a new exact schedule revision). The digest includes birth_tick and next_due_tick; Shard::set_due changes next_due_tick without incrementing material_revision. Reusing by material_revision alone is invalid.
candidate_reuse_not_implemented.terrain_rectangles: Exact owner/session plus chunk id/revision/digest; reset/replacement must invalidate. Keep current chunk identity freshly published.
candidate_reuse_not_implemented.shard_rectangles: Full handle plus exact geometry revision/mask/shape identity; geometry ACK, fragmentation and retirement still publish fresh state.
candidate_reuse_not_implemented.publication: Keep every accepted native pose serial, native tick, transaction, lifecycle, geometry/applied revision and World revision fresh. Do not skip a physical receipt because cell arrays are unchanged.

scope_limits: The counters identify facade work as the dominant part of snapshot stage; no per-function facade timing isolates payload hashing from Variant/packed-array marshalling.
Coordinator snapshot timing is nested within owner snapshot stage. Receipt pump also nests stages and waits; these counters are not disjoint wall-time components.
Eliminating the entire measured snapshot stage would remove only 12.4% of this recorded wall interval; an actual optimization would save less and needs a matched run.
Headless process with one 98x125 shard, not physical GPU presentation and not a multi-body extrapolation.
This source investigation does not change the displayed-performance HOLD or justify late native modification.
